newsitem.title: USA: Brightpoint unit gets $25 mln credit.
newsitem.headline: Brightpoint unit gets $25 mln credit.

text.p: Brightpoint Inc said Tuesday it obtained a commitment for additional credit facilities totaling $25 million dedicated to the company's Brightpoint International Ltd subsidiary.
It said its new credit facilities are in addition to Brightpoint's existing $75 million revolving line of credit. Current borrowings under the existing facility are $22.5 million.

The new facilities provide for potential acquisitions and working capital needs of Brightpoint International, which is based in Manchester, England, and is responsible for Brightpoint's sales and marketing efforts outside North and South America.
Brightpoint distributes wireless communication equipment and related products globally.
